name: Alchemy MCP Server
description: Query blockchain data from coding agents: token prices, NFTs, balances, transaction history, simulation and traces across 100+ chains via Alchemy's hosted MCP server.

skills.name: Onchain JSON-RPC
skills.description: Calls standard EVM and Solana JSON-RPC methods such as balances, blocks and transactions on 100+ networks through an Alchemy app.

skills.name: Token and NFT Data
skills.description: Fetches token balances, metadata, allowances, NFT metadata and multi-chain portfolio data through Alchemy's REST data APIs.

skills.name: Token Prices
skills.description: Looks up current token prices by symbol or contract address and returns historical token prices.

skills.name: Simulation and Tracing
skills.description: Simulates transactions and bundles for asset changes and execution traces, and traces or debugs mined transactions and blocks.

skills.name: App Management
skills.description: Lists the user's Alchemy apps and selects one, caching its API key for the RPC and data tools in the session.
